sections.content: Combine the main A2 time frames. Use the pretérito perfecto for recent experiences connected to the present, the pretérito indefinido for completed events, ir a + infinitive for immediate plans and the futuro simple for predictions and longer-term goals. Familiar connectors and comparatives can help link the ideas.

items.spanish: Hemos aprendido mucho desde aquel día.
items.english: We have learnt a lot since that day.

items.spanish: Van a empezar un nuevo capítulo.
items.english: They are going to begin a new chapter.
The world will be their classroom.

sections.content: It's fitting that the course's last grammar point is also a map of all four tenses: *hemos aprendido* closes the loop back to day one, while *caminaron*, *van a empezar* and *será* send the story — and you — forward.
